full_name: Bruce Western | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Social Sciences Evelyn Green Davis Fellow Harvard University
bio: Bruce Western is a professor of sociology, the Guggenheim Professor of Criminal Justice Policy, the director of the Malcolm Wiener Center for Social Policy, and faculty chair of the Program in Criminal Justice at the Harvard Kennedy School. His research examines trends in American economic inequality and the growth of the US penal population.
